framework: SR 26-2 structure (inventory, materiality = exposure x purpose, effective challenge, monitoring)
disclaimer: Engineering implementation on synthetic data; not a compliance attestation.

models.name: Ridge liquidity forecaster
models.purpose: Forecast each bank's large-value outflow per 15 minutes; feeds MPC buffers
models.inputs: own lagged flows, time of day, tier

checks.check: skill vs seasonal-naive challenger (MASE, 15 min)
90% interval coverage, in distribution (1 h)
90% interval coverage under shift, static intervals (1 h)
90% interval coverage under shift, adaptive intervals (1 h)

limitations: trained and tested on synthetic days from one topology
static conformal intervals lose coverage under a volume shift; use the adaptive intervals

models.name: Constrained PPO liquidity controller
models.purpose: Propose cross-rail liquidity transfers; every proposal passes the fail-closed safety controller
models.inputs: per-bank balances, queues, time to close, recent instant outflows
models.challenger: MPC (linear programme) and the rule-based treasury

models.name: Supervised payment-anomaly classifier
models.purpose: Rank payments for human review before release; never blocks a payment on its own
models.inputs: log_amount, corridor_z, sender_z, corridor_novelty, time_surprise, sender_burst_5m, sender_value_5m, receiver_fan_in_30m, limit_proximity, repeat_60s, is_instant

checks.check: PR-AUC on held-out days
recall at 1.0% alert rate
worst recall on a typology never seen in training

limitations: labels are injected synthetic typologies, not observed fraud
typologies with one incident per day have few test cases
must run alongside the rule set: the two catch different patterns

non_model_tools.name: MPC liquidity optimiser (LP / MILP)
non_model_tools.why_excluded: deterministic optimisation given its inputs; its forecast input is inventoried
non_model_tools.controls: unit and property tests, safety controller, replay verification

non_model_tools.name: Netting (heuristic, LP rounding, exact MILP)
non_model_tools.controls: property test against brute force, duplicate-selection assertion, optimality-gap study

non_model_tools.name: Robust-z payment alert rule
non_model_tools.controls: evaluated as the challenger in results/anomaly_detection.json

non_model_tools.name: Decision Center analyst
non_model_tools.why_excluded: keyword routing to deterministic queries; no generative model
non_model_tools.controls: every number cited to a source field; cannot execute actions

agentic_components.name: Agent tool layer and MCP server
agentic_components.scope_note: generative / agentic systems are outside SR 26-2; governed by the controls listed
controls: read-only and what-if tools only, no settlement or transfer tool exists
hash-chained audit log of every tool call
grounding evaluation: numbers in an answer must appear in tool output
